units.source_text: 白菊尚未全然变紫。

en.t: The white chrysanthemums had not yet turned fully purple.

units.source_text: 其中特别用心栽培的，变紫反而更迟。

en.t: Those that had been cultivated with special care were, if anything, slower to turn purple.

units.source_text: 但不知怎的，只有一枝已经变成非常美丽的紫色。

en.t: Yet somehow, one branch alone had already changed to a very beautiful purple.

units.source_text: 匂亲王命人将这一枝折取过来，

en.t: Prince Niou had someone break off that branch and bring it to him,

units.source_text: 口中诵着“不是花中偏爱菊”的古诗。

en.t: while reciting the old poem, "It is not that among flowers I love the chrysanthemum alone."

units.source_text: 对二女公子说道：“从前有一位亲王，

en.t: He said to the Second Princess, "Long ago there was a prince,

units.source_text: 傍晚时吟着此诗而观赏菊花，

en.t: who, one evening, admired chrysanthemums while chanting this poem,

units.source_text: 忽然一位古代天人从空中翱翔而来，

en.t: when suddenly an ancient heavenly being came soaring through the sky,

units.source_text: 把琵琶秘曲教给他。

en.t: and taught him a secret piece for the biwa.

units.source_text: 但今世万事都浅薄了，实甚可叹。”

en.t: But in this age everything has grown shallow; it is truly lamentable."

units.source_text: 便停止弹奏，放下了琵琶。

en.t: Then he stopped playing and set down the biwa.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得遗憾，说道：“只是人心变得浅薄罢了，

en.t: The Second Princess felt disappointed and said, "It is only people's hearts that have grown shallow;

units.source_text: 古代传下来的技术怎么会变呢？”

en.t: how could techniques handed down from ancient times ever change?"

units.source_text: 她似乎想听一听自己已经荒疏了的古传手法。

en.t: She seemed to want to hear the ancient transmitted style that she herself had already let grow rusty.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“那么，我一人弹奏太单调，

en.t: Prince Niou said, "In that case, it is too monotonous for me to play alone,

units.source_text: 你来和我合奏吧。”

en.t: so come and play together with me."

units.source_text: 便命侍女把筝取来，叫二女公子弹奏。

en.t: He then ordered an attendant to bring the koto and had the Second Princess play it.

units.source_text: 二女公子说道：“从前也曾有人教过我来，

en.t: The Second Princess said, "Someone did teach me long ago,

units.source_text: 但现在都已记不清楚了。”

en.t: but now I no longer remember it clearly."

units.source_text: 她似乎有所顾虑，手也不触筝琴。

en.t: She seemed to have some hesitation and would not even touch the koto.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“这一点点小事，你也要对我见外，实在太无情了！

en.t: Prince Niou said, "To stand on ceremony with me over such a tiny matter is truly heartless!

units.source_text: 我最近逢到的那个人，虽然相处日子不多，尚未熟悉，

en.t: The person I have recently met has spent only a few days with me and is not yet familiar with me,

units.source_text: 但连幼稚的、生疏的事情也不隐瞒我。

en.t: yet she hides from me not even childish or awkward things.

units.source_text: 大凡女子，总须柔顺而天真才好，

en.t: In general, it is best for a woman to be gentle and innocent,

units.source_text: 那位薰中纳言也曾做这样的定评。

en.t: and that Middle Counselor Kaoru once made the same judgment.

units.source_text: 你对此君不是十分信任、非常亲睦的么？”

en.t: Do you not trust that gentleman completely and feel very close to him?"

units.source_text: 他认真地怨恨起来。

en.t: He began to reproach her in earnest.

units.source_text: 二女公子无可奈何，只得拿起筝来，略弹一曲。

en.t: Having no choice, the Second Princess picked up the koto and played a short piece.

units.source_text: 弦线已弛，所以这一回弹南吕调。

en.t: The strings had already slackened, so this time she played in the Nanryo mode.

units.source_text: 二女公子弹筝的爪音清朗悦耳。

en.t: The sound of the Second Princess's fingernails on the koto was clear and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 匂亲王唱催马乐《伊势海》，嗓音高尚优美。

en.t: Prince Niou sang the saibara song "Ise Sea," and his voice was noble and beautiful.

units.source_text: 众侍女躲在近边的隐蔽地方窃听，大家笑逐颜开。

en.t: The attendant women hid nearby and listened in secret, all breaking into delighted smiles.

units.source_text: 有几个老侍女相与议论：“亲王另有所爱，原是遗憾。

en.t: Several elderly attendants discussed it among themselves: "It is regrettable that the prince has another love.

units.source_text: 然而身份高贵的人，三妻四妾也是理之当然。

en.t: Yet for a person of high rank, having several wives and concubines is only natural.

units.source_text: 我们的小姐毕竟是有福之人。

en.t: Our young lady is, after all, a fortunate person.

units.source_text: 从前孤居在宇治山乡之时，做梦也想不到能交这样的好运。

en.t: Back when she lived alone in the mountain village of Uji, she could not have dreamed of meeting with such good fortune.

units.source_text: 现在她说要重归山乡，真是荒唐的想法！”

en.t: For her now to say she wants to return to the mountain village is truly a foolish idea!"

units.source_text: 她们喋喋不休，年轻的侍女都来制止：“静些！”

en.t: As they kept chattering, the younger attendants all came over to stop them, saying, "Quiet!"
